$description: Every FORMA theme is a handful of parameters. Colors are computed and contrast-proven at build time (scripts/lib/palette.mjs). Fonts with `google` load from Google Fonts; the default theme is self-hosted.

themes.css: .btn, .badge, .tab, .field-label { letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .card { border-width: 1px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--bg-surface), inset 0 0 0 4px var(--border-default); }

themes.css: .btn, .card, .input, .select, .textarea, .dialog, .menu, .popover, .table-wrap, .kpi, .widget, .product, .plan { border-color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--text-primary); } .btn:active { box-shadow: none; transform: translate(4px, 4px); } .t-display-xl, .t-display-lg, .hero-title, .page-title { text-transform: uppercase; }

themes.css: & { background: radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 10% -10%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 22%, transparent), transparent), radial-gradient(900px 500px at 110% 10%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--data-5) 18%, transparent), transparent), var(--bg-base); background-attachment: fixed; } .card, .widget, .kpi, .navbar, .sidebar, .dialog, .menu, .popover, .table-wrap, .chart { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg-surface) 70%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.4); }

themes.css: .card, .btn:not(.btn-ghost, .btn-link, .btn-primary, .btn-accent, .btn-danger, .btn-soft), .kpi, .widget, .input, .select { border-color: transparent; background: var(--bg-base); box-shadow: 6px 6px 14px color-mix(in oklab, black 22%, transparent), -6px -6px 14px color-mix(in oklab, white 55%, transparent); } [data-mode="dark"] .card, [data-mode="dark"] .kpi { box-shadow: 6px 6px 14px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.5), -4px -4px 12px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.04); } .input, .select { box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 8px color-mix(in oklab, black 18%, transparent), inset -3px -3px 8px color-mix(in oklab, white 45%, transparent); }
